## summary statistics 





```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Clean structure & create variable labels
timepoints  <- as.character(thesis_data$`Alveolar Bone height`[1, ])
clean_rows  <- thesis_data$`Alveolar Bone height`[-1, ] %>% fill(1, .direction = "down")
clean_rows$Variable <- paste(clean_rows[[1]], clean_rows[[2]], sep = "_")

# 2. Extract and compute T1
t1_indices <- which(timepoints == "T1")
t1_summary <- clean_rows[, c(ncol(clean_rows), t1_indices)] %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "ID", values_to = "Val") %>%
  mutate(Val = as.numeric(Val)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(T1_N = sum(!is.na(Val)), T1_Mean = round(mean(Val, na.rm=T),4), T1_SD = round(sd(Val, na.rm=T),4), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Extract and compute T2
t2_indices <- which(timepoints == "T2")
t2_summary <- clean_rows[, c(ncol(clean_rows), t2_indices)] %>%
  pivot_longer(-Variable, names_to = "ID", values_to = "Val") %>%
  mutate(Val = as.numeric(Val)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(T2_N = sum(!is.na(Val)), T2_Mean = round(mean(Val, na.rm=T),4), T2_SD = round(sd(Val, na.rm=T),4), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Merge them together into an elegant master table
thesis_final_table <- left_join(t1_summary, t2_summary, by = "Variable")
thesis_final_table= thesis_final_table %>% mutate(percentage_change=round((T2_Mean/T1_Mean-1)*100,4))

# View the final output
thesis_final_table%>%
datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
          caption = "", 
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))
```


* percentage_change=(T2_Mean-T1_Mean-1)*100% 


```{r, message=F, warning=F}

thickness_data <- thesis_data$`Alveolar bone thickness`

# ==============================================================================
# 1. CLEAN UP THE MERGED ROWS (Fill Downward)
# ==============================================================================
# Save the timepoints row exactly like before
timepoints <- as.character(thickness_data[1, ])

# Fill down both column 1 (Jaw) AND column 2 (Site) to fix the empty cells
cleaned_rows <- thickness_data[-1, ] %>% 
  fill(1, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(2, .direction = "down")

# Combine all 3 columns into a distinct variable identifier
# Result format: "Maxillary_UR4 buccal_3mm"
cleaned_rows$Variable <- paste(cleaned_rows[[1]], cleaned_rows[[2]], cleaned_rows[[3]], sep = "_")


# ==============================================================================
# 2. CALCULATE SUMMARY STATISTICS FOR T1
# ==============================================================================
t1_indices <- which(timepoints == "T1")

t1_summary <- cleaned_rows[, c(ncol(cleaned_rows), t1_indices)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Variable, names_to = "Patient_ID", values_to = "Measurement") %>%
  mutate(Measurement = as.numeric(Measurement)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    T1_Sample_Size = sum(!is.na(Measurement)),
    T1_Mean        = round(mean(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),4),
    T1_SD          = round(sd(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),4),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 3. CALCULATE SUMMARY STATISTICS FOR T2
# ==============================================================================
t2_indices <- which(timepoints == "T2")

t2_summary <- cleaned_rows[, c(ncol(cleaned_rows), t2_indices)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Variable, names_to = "Patient_ID", values_to = "Measurement") %>%
  mutate(Measurement = as.numeric(Measurement)) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    T2_Sample_Size = sum(!is.na(Measurement)),
    T2_Mean        = round(mean(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),4),
    T2_SD          = round(sd(Measurement, na.rm = TRUE),4),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 4. MERGE INTO A FINAL COMBINED REPORT
# ==============================================================================
thickness_final_report <- left_join(t1_summary, t2_summary, by = "Variable")

thickness_final_report=thickness_final_report %>% mutate(percentage_change=round((T2_Mean/T1_Mean-1)*100,4))

thickness_final_report %>%
datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
          caption = "", 
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))
```

## T1 vs T2 comparison 

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)

# Create an empty list to store final results for your thesis report
thesis_statistical_reports <- list()

# ==============================================================================
# FUNCTION: Run Paired T-Tests on Wide Data
# ==============================================================================
# This reusable function handles the distinct layouts of your tabs dynamically.
analyze_tab_paired <- function(data_table, tab_name, num_id_cols) {
  
  #data_table = thesis_data$`Alveolar Bone height`
  #num_id_cols=2
  # 1. Capture the timepoints from row 1 and remove it from the dataset
  timepoints <- as.character(data_table[1, ])
  clean_rows <- data_table[-1, ]
  
  # 2. Fill downward to fix missing labels in the descriptive columns
  for (i in 1:num_id_cols) {
    clean_rows <- clean_rows %>% fill(!!sym(names(clean_rows)[i]), .direction = "down")
  }
  
  # 3. Build a unified Variable Name from the descriptive columns
  clean_rows <- clean_rows %>% 
    unite("Variable", 1:num_id_cols, sep = "_", remove = FALSE)
  
  # 4. Separate T1 and T2 columns using our row 1 map
  t1_indices <- which(timepoints == "T1")
  t2_indices <- which(timepoints == "T2")
  
  # Re-isolate patient IDs for matching
  patient_ids <- names(clean_rows)
  
  # Pivot T1 data to long format
  t1_long <- clean_rows[, c("Variable", patient_ids[t1_indices+1])] %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Variable, names_to = "Patient_ID", values_to = "T1_Val") %>%
    mutate(T1_Val = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(T1_Val))) # Cleaned here
  
  # Pivot T2 data to long format
  t2_long <- clean_rows[, c("Variable", patient_ids[t2_indices+1])] %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Variable, names_to = "Patient_ID", values_to = "T2_Val") %>%
    mutate(T2_Val = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(T2_Val))) # Cleaned here
  t2_long$Patient_ID=t1_long$Patient_ID
  
  # 5. Merge T1 and T2 by Variable AND Patient_ID to guarantee perfect pairs
  paired_data <- inner_join(t1_long, t2_long, by = c("Variable", "Patient_ID")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(T1_Val) & !is.na(T2_Val)) # Remove incomplete pairs
  
  # 6. Group by each unique site/tooth and run the Paired T-test
  stats_summary <- paired_data %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(
      Pairs_Count   = n(),
      Mean_T1       = round(mean(T1_Val),4),
      Mean_T2       = round(mean(T2_Val),4),
      Mean_Diff     = round(mean(T2_Val - T1_Val),4),
      # Run t-test safely if there are enough pairs and variance exists
   #   T_Statistic   = if(n() > 1 && var(T2_Val - T1_Val) > 0) t.test(T2_Val, T1_Val, paired = TRUE)$statistic else NA,
      P_Value       = if(n() > 1 && var(T2_Val - T1_Val) > 0) 
        t.test(T2_Val, T1_Val, paired = TRUE)$p.value 
         else NA,
   
   # Calculate Power safely using power.t.test
    Power         = if(n() > 1 && var(T2_Val - T1_Val, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
                      round(
                        power.t.test(
                          n = n(), 
                          sd = min(sd(T1_Val, na.rm = TRUE), sd(T2_Val, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                          delta = abs(mean(T2_Val - T1_Val, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                          sig.level = 0.05,
                          type = "paired" # Crucial change: specifies it's a paired layout
                        )$power, 
                        4
                      )
                    } else { NA },
   
      .groups       = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # --- NEW: MULTIPLE COMPARISON CORRECTIONS ---
    mutate(
      # 'fdr' (or 'BH') controls the False Discovery Rate (Highly recommended for clinical/dental data)
      P_Adj_FDR        = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "fdr"),
      
      # 'bonferroni' is strict and multiplies p-values by the number of tests in this tab
     # P_Adj_Bonferroni = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "bonferroni")
    ) %>%
    # Update significance markers to read off the more reliable FDR adjusted p-value
    mutate(
      Significance_FDR = case_when(
        P_Adj_FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        P_Adj_FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
        P_Adj_FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE              ~ "ns"
      )
    )
    
  
  return(stats_summary)
}

```


* p value thresholds: 

P_Value < 0.001 ~ "***",
P_Value < 0.01  ~ "**",
P_Value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        
        
        


```{r, message=F, warning=F}

# EXECUTE ANALYSIS FOR EACH SPECIFIC TAB
# ==============================================================================

thesis_statistical_reports[["Alveolar_Bone_Height"]] <- analyze_tab_paired(
  data_table = thesis_data$`Alveolar Bone height`,

)
```

## plots 



```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. SEPARATE JAW AND RESHAPE DATA FOR PLOTTING
# ==============================================================================
plot_data <- thesis_statistical_reports[["Alveolar_Bone_Height"]] %>%
  # Separate "Mandibular_LL4 buccal" into Jaw="Mandibular" and Site="LL4 buccal"
  separate(Variable, into = c("Jaw", "Site"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  
  # Reshape Mean_T1 and Mean_T2 into a long format for side-by-side bars
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mean_T1, Mean_T2), 
    names_to = "Timepoint", 
    values_to = "Mean_Value"
  ) %>%
  
  # Clean up the Legend labels
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Mean_T1", "Mean_T2"), labels = c("T1", "T2")))


# ==============================================================================
# 2. CALCULATE STAR POSITION HEIGHTS
# ==============================================================================
p_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Jaw, Site, Significance_FDR) %>%
  summarise(
    Max_Height = max(Mean_Value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 3. GENERATE THE GGPLOT (HORIZONTAL WORKFLOW)
# ==============================================================================
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Site, y = Mean_Value, fill = Timepoint)) +
  # Draw side-by-side bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Add ONLY the Significance stars/ns directly above the bars
  geom_text(
    data = p_labels,
    aes(x = Site, y = Max_Height + 0.2, label = Significance_FDR), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3.5, 
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  # FIX: Set nrow = 1 so Mandibular and Maxillary sit side-by-side horizontally
  facet_wrap(~Jaw, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # Cohesive thesis color palette
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#A0C4FF", "T2" = "#FFADAD")) +
  
  # Axis Labels
  labs(
    x = "Measurement Site / Tooth Structure",
    y = "Mean Alveolar Bone Height (mm)",
    fill = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  
  # Professional theme adjustments
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```






```{r, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ADVANCED STRING SEPARATION & DATA PREPARATION
# ==============================================================================
cleaned_thickness_data <- thesis_statistical_reports[["Alveolar_Bone_Thickness"]] %>%
  # Separate depth (e.g., "Mandibular_LL4 buccal_3mm" -> "Mandibular_LL4 buccal" & "3mm")
  separate(Variable, into = c("Base_Variable", "Depth"), sep = "_(?=[0-9])", extra = "merge") %>%
  
  # Separate Jaw from tooth code (e.g., "Mandibular_LL4 buccal" -> "Mandibular" & "LL4 buccal")
  separate(Base_Variable, into = c("Jaw", "Tooth_Site"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  
  # Extract the Quadrant identifier ("LL", "LR", "UL", "UR")
  mutate(
    Quadrant_Code = substr(Tooth_Site, 1, 2),
    Graph_Group = paste0(Jaw, "_", Quadrant_Code),
    
    # Clean up the X-axis label by removing redundant Quadrant letters (e.g., "LL4 buccal" -> "4 buccal")
    Site_Label = str_replace(Tooth_Site, "^[A-Z]{2}", "")
  ) %>%
  
  # Reshape T1 and T2 columns into long format for side-by-side bars
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mean_T1, Mean_T2), 
    names_to = "Timepoint", 
    values_to = "Mean_Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Mean_T1", "Mean_T2"), labels = c("T1", "T2")))


# ==============================================================================
# 2. CALCULATE STAR POSITION HEIGHTS
# ==============================================================================
p_labels_thickness <- cleaned_thickness_data %>%
  group_by(Graph_Group, Site_Label, Depth, Significance_FDR) %>%
  summarise(
    Max_Height = max(Mean_Value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 3. LOOP AND GENERATE THE 4 INDIVIDUAL PLOTS
# ==============================================================================
target_graphs <- c("Mandibular_LL", "Mandibular_LR", "Maxillary_UL", "Maxillary_UR")
thickness_plots <- list()

for (current_graph in target_graphs) {
  
  # Filter data for this specific quadrant loop iteration
  subset_plot_data <- cleaned_thickness_data %>% filter(Graph_Group == current_graph)
  subset_p_labels  <- p_labels_thickness %>% filter(Graph_Group == current_graph)
  
  # Construct the standalone figure using native ggplot2 faceting for structural layout
  thickness_plots[[current_graph]] <- ggplot(subset_plot_data, aes(x = Depth, y = Mean_Value, fill = Timepoint)) +
    # Draw side-by-side bars for T1/T2
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity", 
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
      width = 0.7, 
      color = "black", 
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    
    # Float significance stars safely over the depth intervals
    geom_text(
      data = subset_p_labels,
      aes(x = Depth, y = Max_Height + 0.15, label = Significance_FDR),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    
    # FIX: Facet by Site_Label to group 3mm, 6mm, 9mm cleanly under each tooth type!
    facet_wrap(~Site_Label, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom") +
    
    # Thesis coloring setup
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#A0C4FF", "T2" = "#FFADAD")) +
    
    # Custom titles labeling each figure automatically
    labs(
      title = paste("Alveolar Bone Thickness Changes —", str_replace(current_graph, "_", " ")),
      x = "Measurement Depth (grouped by Tooth Location)",
      y = "Mean Bone Thickness (mm)",
      fill = "Timepoint"
    ) +
    
    # Clean professional engineering theme elements
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      
      # Style the sub-labels (e.g., "4 buccal") to sit cleanly below the depth measurements
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, vjust = 1),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"), # Controls spacing between tooth clusters
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}
thickness_plots[["Mandibular_LL"]]
thickness_plots[["Mandibular_LR"]]
thickness_plots[["Maxillary_UL"]]
thickness_plots[["Maxillary_UR"]]
```

## intra rater reliability 


```{r, message=F, warning=F}
icc_data=read.csv(paste0(path, "/2026/202606/Sarah/plain Thesis Dat_0629_for_icc.csv"),header=T)

library(tidyverse)
library(irr)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ORGANIZE AND SPLIT THE DATA
# ==============================================================================
# Fill down the missing 'X' labels (like U4s, U6s) so every row has its group name
icc_cleaned <- icc_data %>%
  fill(X, .direction = "down") %>%
  # Combine Tooth and Landmark to create a completely unique identifier
  mutate(Measurement_Key = paste(X, X.1, sep = "_"))

# Split the data into Time 1 (Rows 1-10) and Time 2 (Rows 11-20)
t1_data <- icc_cleaned[1:10, ]
t2_data <- icc_cleaned[11:20, ]

# Select only the columns representing patients/raters (C001 through X150981)
# Excluding column metadata like X, X.1, X.2
rater_cols <- c("C001", "C002", "C003", "C004", "C005", "C006", "C007", "C008", 
                "C009", "C010", "C011", "C013", "C016", "C017", "X151481", "X151211", "X150981")


# ==============================================================================
# 2. RUN THE ICC LOOP FOR EACH LANDMARK REFERENCE
# ==============================================================================
icc_results <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  landmark_name <- t1_data$Measurement_Key[i]
  
  # Extract patient data vectors for T1 and T2, ensuring they are numeric
  v_t1 <- as.numeric(t1_data[i, rater_cols])
  v_t2 <- as.numeric(t2_data[i, rater_cols])
  
  # Bind into a 2-column matrix (Time 1 vs Time 2)
  # Rows = Patients, Columns = Timepoints
  icc_matrix <- cbind(v_t1, v_t2)
  
  # Remove patients that have NA in either T1 or T2 to avoid math failure
  icc_matrix_clean <- na.omit(icc_matrix)
  
  # Run a Two-way, Single-rating, Absolute Agreement ICC Model (ICC(2,1))
  # This matches the standard test-retest guidelines (Koo & Li, 2016)
  icc_test <- icc(
    icc_matrix_clean, 
    model = "twoway", 
    type = "agreement", 
    unit = "single"
  )
  
  # Store core statistics into our list summary dataframe
  icc_results[[landmark_name]] <- tibble(
    Measurement      = landmark_name,
    Valid_Pairs_N    = nrow(icc_matrix_clean),
    ICC_Value        = round(icc_test$value,4),
    Lower_CI_95      = round(icc_test$lbound,4),
    Upper_CI_95      = round(icc_test$ubound,4),
    P_Value          = adjust_pvalue(icc_test$p.value)
  )
}

# Combine list elements into a unified summary table
final_icc_table <- bind_rows(icc_results)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. PRINT REPORT CARD
# ==============================================================================
final_icc_table %>%
datatable(extensions = 'Buttons',
          caption = "", 
            options = list(dom = 'Blfrtip',
                           buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                           lengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50,-1),
                                             c(10,25,50,"All"))))
```
